description: UK statutory residence test for one tax year (6 April to 5 April): automatic overseas tests (under 16 or 46 days, or full-time work abroad), automatic UK tests (183 days, only home, full-time UK work), then the sufficient ties tables. Deeming rule and split year are not applied. UK (gov.uk, HMRC RDR3), as of 2026-11-22. General information only: not tax advice; tax treaties can override the result. Verdict is resident, nonresident or depends.

days.description: Days in the UK in the tax year

residentInPrior3.description: UK resident in at least one of the 3 previous tax years

ties.description: Number of UK ties (family, accommodation, work, 90-day, country)

ukWorkDays.description: Days working more than 3 hours in the UK
